statements.text: The published design profiles lineage-labelled alveolar cells from PBS controls and bleomycin injury at days 14 and 28. This is a lung-state description, not a cross-epithelial transfer test for Ravel A0.
The scRNA-seq preparation pools two mice per experiment. Sequenced cell counts therefore cannot be treated as independent animal replicate counts; library/sample identities still need verification.
The source identifies GSE145031 for lineage-tracing scRNA-seq, GSE144468 for organoid scRNA-seq and GSE144598 for ATAC-seq. The first pilot remains restricted to GSE145031.

Published filtering requires more than 500 and fewer than 7000 detected genes and more than 2000 UMIs; downstream processing uses Scanpy 1.3.6. A fresh implementation must record deviations and qualify its comparison tolerance.
